g.text: ILM platform - local Docker Compose deployment
- REST management: certificate and cryptographic asset inventories
- Profiles: RA, token, compliance, ACME, SCEP, CMP, TSP
- Connectors, discovery, workflows and scheduled jobs
- Settings, users/roles, audit, notifications and dashboard
- ACME, SCEP and CMP client protocols
- OIDC discovery, login, token and logout
- Used internally by Core and Scheduler
Core, Auth and Scheduler use application data;
Deployment represents the development stack in test-ilm/compose.yaml.
Connectors and external certificate authorities / timestamp providers
are integration targets, not deployed by this Compose stack.
